APPROVE

The refactor preserves the original control flow and the `i + 1` line numbers, and every extracted method is well under 15 cognitive complexity. The nested `Reader` can reach the private static helpers (`Key`, `PackageOf`, `Unquote`, `Dependency`, `IsDependencySection`) and nullable flow analysis still holds for the fields, so I expect no new warnings. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build the project. I also assumed `IsDependencySection` matches the inline `dependencies`/`devDependencies`/`optionalDependencies` check it replaces, since its body isn't in the diff.
